question: What was the theme for the International Day for Mine Awareness and Assistance in Mine Action in 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Safe Futures Start Here**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• International Day for Mine Awareness and Assistance in Mine Action:

 4 April.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **International Day for Mine Awareness and Assistance in Mine Action** was declared on **8 December 2005**, to be observed every **4 April**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2025**, the theme for the observance will be **“Safe Futures Start Here”**.

 
 
• 
 
The **28th International Meeting of Mine Action National Directors and United Nations Advisers (NDM-UN28)** will be held from **9 to 11 April 2025**, co-hosted by the **United Nations Mine Action Service (UNMAS)** and the **Geneva International Centre for Humanitarian Demining (GICHD)**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention** was opened for signature in **1997**, and **164 countries** have ratified or acceded to it.

 
 
• 
 
**Article 6 of the Mine Ban Treaty** focuses on **victim assistance**, requiring states parties to provide **care, rehabilitation**, and the **social and economic reintegration of mine victims**.
